literal_meaning: বিধি (divine will or fate) বাম (left or unfavorable)
example_sentences_in_bangla: আজকের দুর্ঘটনায় বিধি বাম হয়েছে বলে মনে হচ্ছে।
পরীক্ষায় ফেল করার পর সে বলল, বিধি বাম।
example_sentences_in_english: It feels like the creator is displeased with today's accident.
After failing the exam, he said the fates were against him.
note: Refers to the idea of divine disfavor in Hindu-Bengali traditions
